steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray.
Press brown sugar into the bottom of the prepared loaf pan; spread ketchup over sugar.

Mix together ground beef, onion, milk, bread crumbs, eggs, parsley, salt, black pepper, and ginger in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Shape beef mixture into a loaf and place into the pan on top of ketchup.
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Healthier Brown Sugar Meatloaf
raw_recipe.description: Make this brown sugar meatloaf recipe for your family tonight and feel good about serving up a healthier version of this old-time comfort food favorite.

review.reviewBody: I followed the recipe closely, only cutting back on the salt a bit and omitting the ginger. I threw in a few seasonings (onion powder, garlic powder, italian seasoning) to give it a little more flavor. I used my Perfect Meatloaf Pan to cook this meat loaf--I had to reverse the brown sugar/ketchup to the top of the meat loaf as my pan has holes in the bottom for the grease to drain. A little over an hour in the oven and fifteen minutes to rest and we were ready to go. Not bad--this was a quick meat loaf that paired well with mashed potatoes and was nice and firm for sandwiches the next day.

Question - Healthier than what? Seems like baking the sugary glaze into the bottom along with the grease makes it less healthy. And the low fat milk and whole wheat crumbs are of negligible difference nutritionally overall. To actually make this healthier, sub 3/4 of an 8 oz can of tomato sauce for milk, use only 1 egg, sub 1/3 C oatmeal for bread crumbs and for the topping use remaining 1/4 can of tomato sauce mixed with up to 2 tsp brown sugar Splenda ( stronger taste and sweetening power). Spread it over the top during the last five minutes of cooking. Great hot or cold in sandwiches.

Delicious Meatloaf!!! I substituted quick oats for the wheat bread crumbs. I also added a touch (1 teaspoon) of balsamic vinegar to the brown sugar sauce. 
Timely tip: Use a muffin pan to bake meatloaves in. Be sure to spray with cooking oil first. Bake 350 for 30- 40 minutes. Let cool for a few minutes and release each meatloaf muffin with a rubber scraper or other heat safe plastic. These individual loaves are convenient and cook quicker than traditional meatloaf in a bread pan. Serve with sauce on the side.

I've been making the "other" brown sugar meatloaf since I started using Allrecipes. This is the same recipe but half the sugar and substituting some healthier alternative ingredients. I had naturally gravitated towards those ingredients anyways so this recipe just matches that agenda. Very tasty! Try subbing in half ground turkey instead of beef to keep the calories even lower! Put the ketchup on top rather than on bottom and use half the ginger called for unless you really love ginger.

I really liked this meatloaf. It made a basic home-style meatloaf. It was nice that I didn't have to figure out a topping later on and it baked with the meatloaf on the bottom. My only changes were I believe the lean ground beef I had was a 2 lb package. I chose to use 1 tsp of salt instead of 1.5 tsp. I figured extra salt could be added and ketchup had plenty. The only bread crumbs I had were panko, so that is what I used. After 1 hour there was a lot of liquid on the top and the onions didn't seem fully cooked. I scraped off the extra liquid, sprayed the top with a little olive oil to crisp it up some, and put it back in the oven. It actually took a full 30 minutes longer. That was no problem, as long as it was fully cooked along with the onions. I turned it out onto a foil lined baking sheet with sides. I suggest that unless a large platter is available as it does produce some excess tomato liquid that can get messy. I got 11 1" slices, approximately, from one loaf, at 196 calories each as made above. Ty

Really enjoyed it!! I used Panko crumbs because that’s what I had(1.5 cups like someone else had suggested) and I opted the onion out and added garlic and onion powder.. and I didn’t have a meatloaf dish so I free cooked it in a pan and put the ketchup mixture &sugar over top! (Also added Worcestershire & mustard to ketchup like another suggested) was awesome. Will keep the recipe!

I hate meatloaf, but tempt me and I'll eat anything. I've used Demerara Sugar, rather than brown sugar for years now. Started using it in my meat rubs, loved the unique taste, reminiscent of Demerara Rum. Have to have a little heat to go with the sweet, a double dash of hot pepper flakes. If you try Demerara go low and slow on the cooking temp or risk a hard candy crust. I use the "Keep warm" function in the oven, it cooks around 200F, until an internal temp of 160F. Count on 2-2 1/2 times on the cooking time. My oven is my -40F winter smoker, works like a charm.
So delicious! I did 2 lbs of meat and 1 1/2ed all the other ingredients. Subbed dried parsley and did it in a mini loaf pan. Love how the ketchup/brown sugar mixture is on the bottom.

I absolutely loved this instead of lean beef I made it with ground turkey, almond milk instead of low-fat milk, and substituted bread crumbs with wheat bread pieces a little garlic powder and onion powder, and I put the glaze (brown sugar and ketchup) on top. My husband went back for seconds within 30 minutes. It's almost gone and I just cooked it a couple hours ago, I will definitely make it again!

Really quick and easy dish...made a dozen in my muffin pan...went off another reviewer's post and sprinkled garlic powder and Italian seasoning to give it a more authentic taste...my non-meatloaf eater ate a half of one...no quarrels here...added to my favorites!!

I made this recently. BEST MEATLOAF EVER! It got rave reviews. I doubled the recipe, but DID NOT double the milk. I am glad I did not. It was the perfect consistency. Also I did not have crackers so I used packaged Italian Seasoned Bread Crumbs. I also DID NOT put the glaze in the bottom of the baking dish. That made no sense to me. I spread it on the top and sides. this is a keeper. Firm (sliced well), juicy, delicious.

I used oatmeal instead of bread, added green peppers and aprox. two teaspoons of Worcestershire sauce and some garlic powder. I also used one lb. lean ground beef and one lb. ground turkey and used Stevia brown sugar ( half the amount called for) and sugar free ketchup. Now it is healthier and delicious!
I did not use ginger but added pimentos.
Really good. Made some minor adjustments as I was out of a couple ingredients. Worked out great.👍
This is my family’s favorite meatloaf! The only difference I made is using Splenda brown sugar. I make individual meatloafs so the grease drains out. Turns out great every time.
I followed the recipe and added green and red peepers and added country bobs sauce to the top.
Great recipe I followed the recipe only made individual meat loves. Delicious!

I like the fact that you offer a healthy choice for making the meatloaf. I have used Ritz Garlic crackers because I didn't have any regular crackers. I'm a diabetic and I don't use saltines. I just recently went back to using ground turkey. I love the recipe. It is tasty and delicious.
This is a really great recipe. My family thoroughly enjoyed it. Thank You Kindly.
We loved this recipe and it was moist.
